ITEM 1 | Red plate about 26 cm across used as scale; a cluster of whole red grapes, smooth glossy skins, some slightly translucent, plus two pale green grapes near the center, occupying roughly the upper-right quarter of the plate, piled about 2-3 grapes high | 150
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-brown chunks, several pieces cut into rounded wedges and halves about 2-3 cm across, matte-to-slightly-glossy surface with a firm, dense look, some with a pale cut face, grouped on the left side of the plate, roughly 2 cm tall pieces stacked in places | 130
ITEM 3 | Whole raw almonds, tan-beige with smooth papery skins and pointed ends, about 2-2.5 cm long, dry and matte, scattered in a loose heap covering roughly the lower-right third of the plate, one or two pieces slightly overlapping, about 1 cm high in layers | 75
